definition.title: Commit
definition.description: Commit the bee's current work in its checkout and report the resulting commit.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Suggested commit message (the agent may refine it).

inputs.name: instruction
inputs.description: Extra guidance appended to the instruction.

inputs.name: urgency
inputs.description: Mailbox urgency for the instruction: now|next|idle (default next).

outputs.name: commitSha
outputs.description: Full sha of the commit that was created (or the existing HEAD when nothing needed committing).

definition.instruction: Commit the work in your checkout now. Stage only the changes that belong to your current task, write a clear commit message, and create exactly one commit (if there is nothing to commit, report the current HEAD as commitSha).

messages.body:
[Hive action] Commit — action b53e2d5a-53f0-462b-b4db-8bece4b7c771, attempt 1

Commit the work in your checkout now. Stage only the changes that belong to your current task, write a clear commit message, and create exactly one commit (if there is nothing to commit, report the current HEAD as commitSha).

When you are done, report the outcome with the hive CLI. Finishing your turn does NOT complete this action; only the report does:
  hive action report b53e2d5a-53f0-462b-b4db-8bece4b7c771 --attempt 1 --token c1e21569529aa46a4235 --succeeded --output commitSha=<commitSha>
  hive action report b53e2d5a-53f0-462b-b4db-8bece4b7c771 --attempt 1 --token c1e21569529aa46a4235 --failed --detail "<why>"
  hive action report b53e2d5a-53f0-462b-b4db-8bece4b7c771 --attempt 1 --token c1e21569529aa46a4235 --ask "<question for the operator>"    (holds the queue until answered; the answer arrives as mail)
  hive action report b53e2d5a-53f0-462b-b4db-8bece4b7c771 --attempt 1 --token c1e21569529aa46a4235 --progress "<short status>"

Outputs:
- commitSha (required): Full sha of the commit that was created (or the existing HEAD when nothing needed committing).
- branch: Branch the commit is on.

Queued actions after this one wait for your report; do not start them yourself.
